scope: issues from August 8 to October 6, 2026, every merchant

u: Labels never charged to Izzy Zero Waste Beauty, DKOldies and ro•sham•bo eyewear cost about $7,000 on 887 USPS shipments, and it is still happening.
Weights and box sizes set too low at ZERO FOXTROT and Ballerina Farm cost about $3,800 since mid September.
FedEx import tax bills at District Vision and LA Clippers Team Store were not passed on, about $3,100.
o: DHL eCommerce charges less than our label price at Freckled Poppy, FB County and Worth Collective, about $9,500. Confirm these prices are intended.
Pond Pro Canada and one unlinked UPS account were charged about $7,300 more in UPS fees than UPS billed, and may be owed credits.

u|69a89b9e9a879990e4d1e698|USPS|M|label_.cause: We refunded about $6,200 on 713 cancelled labels, but USPS has refunded only $5,100 so far and charged us for 31 of them.

u|69726ff1809a5cc0e538c8cd|UPS|C|currenc.type: Canadian bills above the label price
u|69726ff1809a5cc0e538c8cd|UPS|C|currenc.cause: Boxes are declared as 12 by 12 by 18 inches, but UPS measured 19 by 13 by 13 inches on every shipment we can check, and UPS adds fuel and sales tax.
u|69726ff1809a5cc0e538c8cd|UPS|C|currenc.fix: Correct the saved box size, pass fuel and tax charges on, and bill the {amount}.

u|66fb263634259e19afad86c9|USPS|C|base_i.cause: Labels say 2.8 pounds in a 12 by 9 by 3 inch box, but USPS billed 8.5 pounds in a 16 by 16 by 8 inch box. The products alone weigh about 5.6 pounds.
u|66fb263634259e19afad86c9|USPS|C|base_i.fix: Correct the product weights and box size saved in the store, then bill the {amount}.

u|682f9f8e377e4efd2f893a95|FedEx|C|prior.cause: FedEx billed import tax and VAT on international orders after delivery, and none of it was passed on.
u|682f9f8e377e4efd2f893a95|FedEx|C|prior.fix: Pass import tax bills on to the merchant automatically, or ship with taxes paid up front, and bill the {amount}.
